run_navigation_to_goal: run the robot to navigate to a single goal specified by x,y,theta coordinates
run_navigation_to_waypoints: run the robot to navigate through multiple waypoints from a YAML config file
run_navigation_and_dock: run the robot to navigate to waypoints then dock automatically after completion
run_navigation_save_trajectories: run the robot navigation and save trajectory data to a timestamped JSON file
parse_arguments: parse command line arguments for goal coordinates, waypoints, docking, and trajectory save path
